title: Vitamin Sea | 5BR Rental on Seagrove Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Vitamin Sea of Seagrove is a signature 5BR home featuring a private pool and a carriage house. This luxury 30A rental sleeps 17 by Royal Destinations. Book today!
description_expanded: Description: Vitamin of Seagrove by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 164 Elm Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Welcome to Vitamin Sea of Seagrove! This coastal retreat and its charming carriage house offer plenty of space for the entire family (including extended family) to relax, reconnect, and make lasting memories. Designed with comfort and togetherness in mind, Vitamin Sea of Seagrove features bright, open living spaces that flow seamlessly from indoors to outdoors, creating the perfect setting for beachside living. Gather around the private pool for afternoon grilling and laughter, or take a short bike ride to one of the most beautiful beach access points on 30A. Whether it’s morning coffee on the porch, a family dinner under the stars, or a quiet evening by the water, every moment here feels like a true escape. With thoughtful design to accommodate two to three small families, this home offers generous spaces for adults, kids, and teens alike — ensuring everyone finds their favorite spot to unwind. From its modern comforts to its unbeatable Seagrove location, Vitamin Sea of Seagrove is the perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and coastal charm. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.5 Mile/ 9-minute walk -Main House and Carriage House -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: 16 (6 Outside / 6 Inside Dining Table / 5 Island) -Private Pool: Large Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $300 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 17 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Baths First Floor (Main House): -Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom, Soaking Tub with Separate Shower -Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Shared Full Hallway Bath -Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed, Shared Full Hallway Bath -Living / Dining / Kitchen / Half Bath / Pool Lanai -Laundry Room Second Floor (Main House): -Guest Bedroom 4: Four Queen Beds, Private Bath Carriage House: -Guest Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Twin Pull Out Trundle -Kitchen / Dining / Full Bath / Access to Pool and Lanai Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
